name: Gree
description: The Gree were a species of tentacled gray cephalopods from the planet Gree in the Outer Rim Territories. Each Gree had six tentacles and an oversized head, in comparison to baseline and near-Human body proportions, and stood between 0.8 and 1.2 meters tall. Gree evolved in a Type II atmosphere, and generally covered their lower faces with odd spongy devices (presumably breath masks) in Type I atmospheres.
